create_sqlite_stats_writer: create a SQLiteStatsWriter instance with a shared buffer queue and start the background writer thread
query_task_stats: query task statistics from the SQLite database filtered by task name and time range
query_queue_stats: query queue statistics from the SQLite database filtered by queue name and time range
query_event_stats: query event statistics from the SQLite database filtered by event name and time range
log_stats_summary: log a summary of all collected task and queue statistics from the SQLite database
